ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 65% of the visible surface area, contrasting with low-intensity black/dark-grey pigmentation covering 35%, primarily concentrated at the notch and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions in the central and upper-distal areas of both lobes. Heavy black pigmentation originates at the median notch and radiates along the inferior leading edge and superior trailing edge. Transition zones exhibit high-frequency speckled mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with an internal angle of approximately 42 degrees relative to the lobe intersection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Amplitude of variations ranges from 3 to 12 pixels. Significant jagged deformation on the terminal tip of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave sweep trajectory from the median notch to the distal lobe tips, exhibiting a marked upward curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast cluster of three-dimensional calcified protrusions (barnacles) on the left lobe tip; secondary, less dense cluster on the right lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent diagonal dark linear disruption on the mid-lateral field of the left lobe; one vertical dark linear disruption on the mid-lateral field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct dark focal spot (circular pigmentation anomaly) in the lower quadrant of the right lobe; significant barnacle colonization causing structural irregularity on distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jagged profile of the left fluke tip caused by heavy barnacle encrustation, deviating from the smooth trailing edge contour.
